suggestions: I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that goes green on the first try, no re-run needed.
I'm thankful for the ustaz's khutbah actually being short today so I could beat the parking rush.
I'm grateful for my mom packing extra rendang in the container even though I only asked for one scoop.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that saved me from shipping a race condition nobody would've caught for weeks.
I'm grateful for the first sip of teh tarik after a meeting that ran way too long.
I'm thankful for waking up on my own five minutes before the alarm, right in time for subuh.
I'm grateful for a senior engineer who explained the legacy codebase instead of just telling me to go read it myself.
I'm thankful for the highway being clear on the one day I actually left the house late.
I'm grateful for a bank transfer that went through instantly instead of the usual pending screen for an hour.
I'm thankful for my little brother still asking me to help debug his school laptop, even though he could probably Google it faster.
I'm grateful for a customer bug report that turned out to be a one-line fix instead of the disaster the title made it sound like.
I'm thankful for the office pantry actually restocking the good coffee before I ran out of patience.
I'm grateful for rezeki showing up as an unexpected freelance gig right when the car needed new brake pads.
I'm thankful for a group chat that still remembers to check in on each other, not just forward memes.
I'm grateful for the breeze right before Maghrib that makes sitting outside actually bearable.
